description: POST /v1/logs and /v1/traces answer 200 {} without parsing or storing anything: prompt text, tool arguments, response text and api_response token counts in logs produce no event; malformed JSON on /v1/logs is still 200; a metrics-shaped body on /v1/logs neither emits nor sets a baseline; the bearer check still applies (401). A logs body on / (where metrics are accepted) stores nothing either. A later /v1/metrics pair proves no baseline was taken from the logs path.
contract: ADR-0016 §3 Receiver ("also accepts POST /v1/logs and /v1/traces and answers 200 {} without parsing or storing the body ... still bounded by the 1 MiB limit and the bearer check"), Settings (logPrompts: false forced); SPRINT-05b Global constraints; TEST_PLAN §S5b (malformed JSON still 200; 401 without bearer); ADR-0011 Receiver (POST / accepted)
